bestBets.overview: CORONATION DAY was not disgraced off a wide run last start. Drawn to get a better run throughout and advantage of apprentice claim a bonus. ANTHROPOLOGY was super first-up. Sure to be better from that outing and this a winnable race. THE DEFENDER resumes from break. Form in Victoria was consistent last time in work and must consider while BESTOV was beaten less than 2 lengths at Rockhampton last start and must consider.

raceTips.comment: DEFENDER resumes for the new stable and the former Victorian impressed wining a recent Rockhampton trial in easy fashion. The noseband comes off, the visors go on and he looks well placed to get that maiden win on the board. ANTHROPOLOGY has been placed in three of her five starts. She kicked off her campaign with a solid effort to finish third over 1200m at Rockhampton and with the added fitness, she’ll be right there at the finish. BESTOV hasn’t had a lot of luck in recent runs. All three placings have been at this trip, she's hard fit and will be strong late. QUEEN OF LIGHT steps out for the new yard. With six weeks since her latest outing, she drops back in distance and she’ll be in it for a long way.

horse.owners: G Bell, T Fenlon, B Fenlon

bestBets.overview: FINAL MISSION is racing in consistent form in this class. Won three back then backed that up with a couple of sound placings. This a nice race for her. BITOFTHEBLARNEY comes off a solid last start minor placing. Aprrentice claim a bonus and would not leave out of place chances. DWAYNE looks the likely leader and if gets cheap sectional can figure while PRIDE OF SAVABELLA was good at Sunshine Coast last start and that form sound for this.

raceTips.comment: BITOFTHEBLARNEY is hard fit and drops back sharply in grade. The mile suits, Kayla Baker takes 2kgs off and he draws to get the right run. PRIDE OF SAVABELLA closed off nicely to claim third when resuming over 1400m at the Sunshine Coast. He’s since been transferred to the Glenda Bell stable and with the added fitness, the rise to the mile looks ideal. FINAL MISSION is hard fit and racing well. The step up in trip suits and she gets in well with the claim. MY GREY is racing well. He’s been placed in all three tries at this track and trip and he can make his presence felt.

bestBets.overview: JUNE won at Eagle Farm two starts back then found the Mackay Cup a bit too hot last start. Back in right race. ZIPITALIST is flying at the moment. Made it three wins from his last four starts in a dominant display last start and he can measure up in better race. ACEDROD jumped to the front and led all the way last start. Will go forward and another that will take catching. NEW LEVEL was in the market last start but virtually eased out of race. Form prior good enough for this.

raceTips.comment: JUNE was a winner at Eagle Farm two runs back but failed to figure last time in the Mackay Cup. Down in class, he drops back in trip and gets the blinkers on again. ZIPITALIST has saluted in three of his past four starts and was dominant winning his latest. He’s untested out to this journey and rises sharply in the weights, but must be respected. NEW LEVEL races well here at Emerald. With a senior rider aboard, he draws well and can bounce back. ACEDROD comes off a dominant 4.5 length victory at Blackall and should have no trouble stepping out to the mile.

bestBets.overview: STECARA finished too well winning this track last start. Only needs to find a similar turn-of-hoof and she can win again. WOLFGANG jumped to the front and led all the way at Rockhampton two starts back then just faded late at Warwick. He can lead and win from inside gate. ARMSTRONG BAY comes off a solid last start win. This no harder and must respect while ELLIBABY won impressively first-up and she is sure to strip fitter from the outing.

raceTips.comment: ELLIBABY proved too good when resuming for the new stable over 1200m at Mackay. She strips fitter and looks well placed to repeat that performance. WOLFGANG won well at Rockhampton two runs back but wanted to overdo it last time after being driven forward off a slow start. He gets the advantage of the inside draw and the claim sees him in nicely. STECARA is a last start winner over this track and trip. She’s since been freshened and the low draw will see her afforded every chance. ARMSTRONG BAY got the job done last start at Longreach. He boasts a strong record at this distance and will be doing his best work late.

bestBets.overview: GREYLIST won with something in hand two starts back then just found one better last start. Should sit off a solid tempo and have last crack at these. GOOD LIEUTENANT was beaten less than a length at big odds at Mackay last start. He was placed in town three back and will go close if finds best. KRACKACAN has the speed to drive across and lead these. If he can steal a break on the corner he takes catching while DIDDLEY SQUAT was too bad to be true last start. Was racing well prior and cannot dismiss.

raceTips.comment: CONTEMPORARY kicks off for the new stable. The former Godolphin galloper is eight weeks between runs, he races well fresh and is sure to find this easier than what he’s previously contested. He’s drawn well and will be strong late. ASTAPOR is another that will find this easier that what he’s used too. Now a gelding, he’s a smart horse on his day and the 1000m first up will suit. GOOD LIEUTENANT was only narrowly beaten when resuming over 1200m at Mackay. He strips fitter and the drop back to 1000m won’t hurt. WOODSTOCK ROCK resumes. He’s proven fresh and the low draw will see him afforded every chance.

bestBets.overview: JUST A COSMIC GIRL has plenty of early speed and she should get the chance to control this from the front and make it two wins in a row. SPITZBERG won from on the speed at Rockhampton two starts back then too bad to be true at Gladstone last start. He can bounce back. COSMIC ARC has been bit disappointing in her last couple but she finds winnable race while MIDNIGHT MAGGIE comes off a dominant last start win and from perfect draw she gets chance.
bestBets.suggestedBet: Each Way JUST A COSMIC GIRL

raceTips.comment: SPITZBERG scored over 1200m at Rockhampton two runs back but was always wide last start in stronger grade and failed to finish off. He’ll find this easier and the low draw is a big plus. HOT TORQUE INVEGAS hasn’t been far away in recent runs. She looks well placed with the slight drop in grade. JUST A COSMIC GIRL comes off a strong maiden win over 1200m at Blackall. Lightly raced, she’s an improving type but she may be looking for further. MIDNIGHT MAGGIE is a last start winner and can go on with it.

bestBets.overview: VIKING TREASURE made it two in a row with an all the way win at Roma last start. If she can find the front and control this she can make it three on the trot. YES LARRY resumes from spell. He won three of his four starts at first prep and looks promising. STRAYA PRIDE chased home well enough when beaten just on a length last start. He looks well placed while ENTITLE comes off a last start Roma placing and she can figure in exotics.

raceTips.comment: YES LARRY resumes. A winner of three from four, he’s a talented horse with a bright future and the 1200m kick off here looks ideal. HEROIC TALENT looks well placed dropping back in grade and in distance. The low draw will see him afforded every chance and he'll be strong at the finish. BILLY BOOM is hard fit and racing well. He charged home from the tail last start over 1100m at Mackay and will relish the extra 100m here.VIKING TREASURE will look to make it a hat-trick of wins and she gets in nicely with the claim.
